rcases h_T014 with ⟨hn, hcard, hred, β, hstr, hdiv, hfac, hmat, hinv⟩
constructor
· let i₀ : Chevalley.Index ell := ⟨0, hn⟩
  exact nontrivial_of_ne (β i₀) 0 (β.ne_zero i₀)
· intro W hx hy hh
  by_cases hW : W = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hW
  · right
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hw0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hW
    have hc : ∃ j, β.coord j w ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hc
      apply hw0
      apply β.forall_coord_eq_zero_iff.mp
      intro j
      by_contra hj
      exact hc ⟨j, hj⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hc
    apply (Submodule.eq_top_iff_forall_basis_mem β).mpr
    intro i
    have ht : Chevalley.matrixK K ell M x y i j w ∈ W :=
      hinv W hx hy i j w hw
    rw [(hmat i j).2] at ht
    have hs : β.coord j w • β i ∈ W := by
      simpa only [Chevalley.unitOp, LinearMap.smulRight_apply] using ht
    have hi := W.smul_mem (β.coord j w)⁻¹ hs
    simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hj, one_smul] using hi

T015 : ∀ (V : Type) [instV : AddCommGroup V] [instCV : Module ℂ V] (K : Type) [instK : Field K] (p : ℕ) (ell : ℤ)
  (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ ell ∧ ell < ↑p →
    (0 < ell.toNat + 1 ∧
        Fintype.card (Chevalley.Index ell) = ell.toNat + 1 ∧
          Chevalley.reductions K p M ∧
            ∃ β,
              Chevalley.stringActions ell (Chevalley.opK K M x) (Chevalley.opK K M y) (Chevalley.opK K M h)
                  (Chevalley.basisVec β) ∧
                Chevalley.dividedActions ell (fun r => Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp x r))
                    (fun r => Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp y r)) (Chevalley.basisVec β) ∧
                  (∀ r ≤ ell.toNat,
                      ↑r.factorial ≠ 0 ∧
                        Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp x r) = (↑r.factorial)⁻¹ • Chevalley.opK K M x ^ r ∧
                          Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp y r) = (↑r.factorial)⁻¹ • Chevalley.opK K M y ^ r) ∧
                    (∀ (i j : Chevalley.Index ell),
                        ↑(ell.toNat.choose ↑j) ≠ 0 ∧ Chevalley.matrixK K ell M x y i j = Chevalley.unitOp β i j) ∧
                      ∀ (W : Submodule K (Chevalley.VK K M)),
                        Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.opK K M x) →
                          Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.opK K M y) →
                            ∀ (i j : Chevalley.Index ell), Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.matrixK K ell M x y i j)) →
      Nontrivial (Chevalley.VK K M) ∧
        ∀ (W : Submodule K (Chevalley.VK K M)),
          Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.opK K M x) →
            Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.opK K M y) → Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.opK K M h) → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
